name: Checkered Melon Beetle
desc: Checkered Melon Beetle (Paranapiacaba tricincta): eats plants or other primary food sources. Recorded 8 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Paranapiacaba tricincta, the checkered melon beetle, is a species of skeletonizing leaf beetle or flea beetle in the family Chrysomelidae. It is found in Central America and North America.
